description: The exact data a theme renders with (the StorefrontData Liquid objects are built from): the business (localized, brand site applied), every active menu with items, primary menu id, loyalty/ordering flags, the stamp-card program and its resolved style — plus theme_data (the site document) and live_theme. Use it to preview or test theme code locally.

locale.description: Defaults to the business's default locale
